title: Grading Arizona football’s performance in loss to BYU

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Grading Arizona football’s performance in loss to BYU
sources.description: In the first big test of the season, Arizona traveled to BYU and kept in touch with the Cougars but ultimately fell 28-17 in a hard fought battle. In the first half, the Wildcats looked like they were up to the task but a second half shutout killed any confidence from the first 30 minutes. […]
